title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Parallax Mapping / Plugin Help

posts.author: Sonuko
posts.body:
Hello, I'm completely new to rpgmaker and this forum in general, so sorry if I make any mistakes.
So I'm trying to make a parallax map and I followed a tutorial (Starlit Castle's Parallax Mapping Tutorial for RPG Maker ||
). I have:
> made my map
> Downloaded GALV's MZ layer graphic plugin (
https://galvs-scripts.com/?s=layer
)
> Made layers folder
> Imported the components of my maps onto said layers folder
> Turned on the Galv's layers plugin
> Put this in the Notes section "LAYER_S 1 room 0 0 255 1 0"
> Changed the width and height of the map to correspond/match to the image
And I ended up with this empty background when the tutorial and other tutorials I've followed were able to easily import their maps. I probably messed up the process of inputing the plugin, but it's like it can't find my map.
As an absolute newbie, I'd really appreciate the help as I'm feeling discouraged that I can't even do something this simple. Thank you so much for taking the time to read this.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I didn't really spend time thinking what might be wrong, but I just noticed that in your pic you have a = symbol at the end of your notes line? Should that be there? (also just in case, you shouldn't put quotation marks in the note line, if you did that)

Greetings,
Your issue is that, in order to see the map in-editor, you must export your map created in your art editor of choice (all layers merged) as a picture saved into the Parallax folder of your game. Then set that picture as the Parallax Background of your map. Always begin the title of the save with a "!", so it would look like "!Classroom" (no quotations).
Then you will be able to see your map in the editor
.
PS: Remember to remove that parallax background after you are done tweaking your map/events in-editor or else you will have two copies of it layered over top of each other in-game!
Happy game making,
-Niniann
